newsitem.title: NORWAY: SOCCER-NORWAY LOOK TO ENGLISH EXILES.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-NORWAY LOOK TO ENGLISH EXILES.

text.p: Norway coach Egil Olsen has included eight English-based players in his squad for the World Cup qualifier away to Switzerland on November 10.
However, a ninth, striker Lars Bohinen of Blackburn Rovers, has been dropped after a disappointing showing in the 3-0 win over Hungary this month.

Announcing his choice for the European group three game in Berne, Olsen hinted at a tactical change, saying: "We have had problems with 4-4-2, now perhaps we have players who can fill the positions in 4-5-1.

"Switzerland have two very good headers of the ball in centre of defence. Stephane Henchoz and Ramon Vega are tough and strong, and demolished Finland in the air. But we will be able to challenge in the air, on the flanks and at the back."
Goalkeepers - Frode Grodaas (Chelsea, England), Joern Jamtfall (Rosenborg).

Defenders - Henning Berg (Blackburn, England), Stig Inge Bjoernebye (Liverpool, England), Alf-Inge Haaland (Nottingham Forest, England), Ronny Johnsen (Manchester United, England), Tore Pedersen (St Pauli, Germany), Bent Skammelsrud (Rosenborg).

Midfielders/strikers - Haavard Flo (Werder Bremen, Germany), Tore Andre Flo (Brann), Oeyvind Leonhardsen (Wimbledon, England), Erik Mykland (Linz, Austria), Kjetil Rekdal (Rennes, France), Petter Rudi (Molde), Staale Solbakken (Lillestroem), Ole Gunnar Solskjaer (Manchester United, England), Frank Strandli (Lillestroem), Egil Oestenstad (Southampton, England).
